objective: Measure the exact-row offline opportunity for an up-to-eight-source signed row-coherent fold with stationary Acc32/ATLIF state on frozen H67 ep35 Conv, adjacent Conv-to-ATLIF, and FC1 records.

population.local_payload_limit: 160 unique target records = 60 Conv plus 100 FC1; the 40 Conv-to-ATLIF records are a subset of the 60 Conv records. Ten manifest-listed preds.3.conv.0 payloads are absent locally.

dse.same_resource_rule: The strong K8-resident baseline and M484 both have N signed source lanes, the same N-input reduction tree, identical state/psum ports, and keep the full Acc32 row resident from activation through commit. K1-resident is reported only as a resource-scaling reference.
dse.finite_slot_rule: Offline destination-major order requires one live row and therefore has zero slot stalls. This does not model the reorder producer and cannot be used as online feasibility evidence.
dse.online_original_order_rule: FC1 C-last rows are exact online-contiguous; Conv NCHW receives only a one-source-per-packet safe lower bound and is NO-GO without a measured reorder frontend.

gate.pass_if: M484 versus strong same-resource K8-resident cycles >= 1.20x OR logical resident-state plus weight plus metadata traffic reduction >= 30%
